channel.title: SnowScope · Snow reports
channel.description: Daily snow reports for skiers: where the snow is, what is coming and where to ski, from the SnowScope snow map and measuring stations. Every number comes from that day's data.

item.title: Oukaïmeden notebook: skiing Morocco's Atlas when the snow comes
item.description: A practical notebook on Oukaïmeden in the High Atlas: when snow usually comes, how much, which slopes to aim for and how to get there from Marrakesh.

item.title: Michlifen snow comes in episodes: how to catch a ski day in the Middle Atlas
item.description: Michlifen, near Ifrane, has snow in short episodes rather than a season. What 46 past winters show, why the usual depth is zero, and how to be there on the right days.

item.title: Three day loops from Méribel, the middle of Les 3 Vallées
item.description: Three ways to spend a day from Méribel: east to Courchevel, south towards Val Thorens, or at home on Mont Vallon, with the snow of 46 past winters at three heights.

item.title: A river in the sky over Whistler: why the top gets a metre of snow and the base gets rain
item.description: About 192 mm of water on Whistler's upper slopes from 7 to 12 November: the 0 °C level swings between 1,410 and 2,920 m, snow up high, rain below.

item.title: Whistler storm: about 92 cm up high, rain on the North Shore – the next days in motion
item.description: A wet Pacific storm: 92 cm of new snow on Whistler's upper slopes from 8 to 10 November, rain below about 1,620 m.

item.title: Pyrenees: no snow yet at Baqueira-Beret – this winter against last winter
item.description: 0 cm at 2,052 m on 7 November, as in many past winters. Last winter peaked at 100.6 cm. Interactive chart and data.

item.title: Alps: where it will snow and where it will rain, 8 to 10 November
item.description: Mild air with the next rain and snow: the snow line sits mostly between 2,190 and 2,850 m. Map, chart and animation.

item.title: High Atlas: rain up to about 3,710 m – only the highest summits turn white
item.description: Snow line near 3,710 m from 8 to 12 November: rain at Oukaïmeden and Imlil, snow on Toubkal's summit. Map and chart.
